The error occurred because R8/ProGuard shrinks and strips generic type signatures by default in minified release builds (`isMinifyEnabled = true`). When `TypeToken` attempts to inspect its generic superclass at runtime via reflection, it finds raw class metadata instead of `ParameterizedType`, triggering:

```
java.lang.IllegalStateException: TypeToken must be created with a type argument: new TypeToken<...>() {}; When using code shrinkers (ProGuard, R8, ...) make sure that generic signatures are preserved.
```

### Changes Made

Updated [app/proguard-rules.pro](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c4-agy-B-r5/work/app/proguard-rules.pro) with the necessary R8/ProGuard rules:

1. **Preserved generic signatures**: Added `-keepattributes Signature` so generic type parameters on classes and methods remain accessible to reflection.
2. **Preserved `TypeToken` subclasses**: Added rules to keep `com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken` and classes extending it.
3. **Preserved model classes**: Kept `vn.shelftap.lab.model.**` so Gson can match JSON keys to `Book` fields via reflection without fields being renamed or removed during obfuscation.
